source: derived: horizons marched over the LOLA LDEM 75S 240 m heights at 30 cells and 24 azimuths; Sun and Earth directions from the JPL DE440 ephemerides every 6 h of 2027
note: Share of 2027 with the Sun AND the Earth above the regional horizon at the same time: the proxy of the useful hours (the Sun and Earth layers alone are marginals). At about 2.4 km per cell: relief smaller than a cell is not resolved. Not validated against NASA illumination products. Cells within 72 km of the rim have no data.
